- Next: run make lint and make test, then inspect git state, commit all required changes, push, and switch tasks.

- Added IdleReason to the test module imports in src/ha/reconcile.rs.
- Next: rerun make lint, then make test if lint is clean.

- make lint passed after the test import fix.

- Next: stage src/ha/reconcile.rs, existing src/ha/decide.rs and .ralph updates, commit, push, and run task_switch.
